name_zh: 伊拉克·西斯特拉尼：什叶大阿亚图拉政治调解与反美伊朗博弈
name_en: Iraq Sistani: Shia Grand Ayatollah Political Mediation & Anti-US Iran Game
description_zh: 阿里·西斯特拉尼 (1930-) 伊拉克什叶大阿亚图拉，2003萨达姆倒台后发布法特瓦指导政治过渡，反对美军占领拒绝会见布什，调解什叶派内部派系冲突，制衡伊朗影响力，成为伊拉克稳定最后防线。
description_en: Ali al-Sistani (1930-) Iraq Shia Grand Ayatollah, 2003 post-Saddam issued fatwa guiding political transition, opposed US occupation refused meeting Bush, mediated Shia internal faction conflicts, checked Iran influence, becoming Iraq stability last defense line.
reason_zh: 西斯特拉尼代表宗教权威如何在世俗政治真空中填补合法性缺口，展示了什叶神学如何通过法特瓦干预国家建构，其反美制衡伊朗双重立场定义了后萨达姆伊拉克政治光谱边界。
reason_en: Sistani represents how religious authority fills legitimacy vacuum in secular political void, demonstrating how Shia theology intervenes in state-building through fatwa, his anti-US checking Iran dual stance defining post-Saddam Iraq political spectrum boundaries.
steps_zh: 研究西斯特拉尼早年马什哈德神学教育与纳杰夫权威确立
分析2003年法特瓦要求选举制宪与反美占领立场
探讨调解马勒基/萨德尔/哈基姆什叶派系冲突
评估制衡伊朗代理民兵与指导2019年抗议运动
总结什叶大阿亚图拉政治调解反美伊朗对伊拉克稳定的决定性支撑
steps_en: Study Sistani early Mashhad theological education and Najaf authority establishment
Analyze 2003 fatwa demanding elections constitution and anti-US occupation stance
Explore mediating Maliki/Sadr/Hakim Shia faction conflicts
Evaluate checking Iran proxy militias and guiding 2019 protests
Summarize Shia Grand Ayatollah political mediation anti-US Iran decisive support for Iraq stability
expected_zh: 理解宗教权威如何在失败国家中成为唯一稳定锚点，掌握法特瓦作为政治干预工具的神学正当性与实践边界，评估西斯特拉尼离世后伊拉克政局的不确定性风险。
expected_en: Understand how religious authority becomes sole stability anchor in failed state, grasp fatwa as political intervention tool theological legitimacy and practical boundaries, evaluate post-Sistani Iraq political uncertainty risks.
case_zh: 1930 出生；2003 法特瓦；反美制衡伊朗；持续。什叶大阿亚图拉政治调解反美伊朗范式永存。
case_en: 1930 birth; 2003 fatwa; anti-US check Iran; ongoing. Shia Grand Ayatollah political mediation anti-US Iran paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Fatwa political intervention; US occupation; Iran influence; Iraq stability
